hero.title: Constant cardiac precision for a full and safe life
hero.subtitle: We integrate clinical-grade devices with AI algorithms to deliver a 360° view of your cardiovascular health in real time
home.intro: AI-driven precision detection and medicine for cardiology
home.card1_desc: In today's healthcare world, precision is essential to provide the best care for our patients. With the help of artificial intelligence and innovation in cutting-edge devices, we are leading the way toward more advanced and personalized cardiac care than ever before.
home.card2_desc: We use proprietary devices specifically designed to measure your cardiovascular health accurately and continuously. These devices include ECGs, holters, patches, implantables, and wearables.
home.card3_desc: Unmatched Precision: Our AI can detect even the subtlest irregularities in your heart rhythm, allowing us to intervene before problems worsen.
home.about_text: At RC Technology, we don't just observe the future of medicine; we are building it. We were born with the mission to bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and heart care, transforming complex biometric data into clear, fast, and accurate diagnoses.

platform.title: RedBeat Health Platform
platform.section1_text: RC Technology's REDBEAT HEALTH PLATFORM is a next-generation digital health solution that transforms reactive cardiac care into a continuous, personalized prevention strategy. Our platform acts as the intelligent core of an ecosystem composed of six interconnected medical devices, designed to monitor cardiovascular health from anywhere.
platform.section2_title: A Comprehensive Real-Time View of the Patient
platform.section2_text: Thanks to our Total Connectivity, all RedBeat range devices —from wearables and medical scales to biomarker meters— automatically sync their data to the cloud. This allows healthcare professionals to access an advanced Monitoring Dashboard, where they can view unified data:
platform.section3_text: The REDBEAT platform not only stores data; it interprets it. We are training Artificial Intelligence models to generate automatic clinical reports that help identify subtle irregularities before they become critical events.
platform.feature1_desc: Heart rate, SpO2, skin temperature, and blood pressure.
platform.feature2_desc: Tracking NT-proBNP levels (heart failure) and Urine Calcium (renal-cardiac risk).
platform.feature3_desc: Comprehensive weight and fluid retention monitoring to prevent decompensation.
platform.feature4_desc: Integration of 12-lead electrocardiograms performed in clinical or home settings.
tech.title: RedBeat Technology
tech.subtitle: The RedBeat ecosystem integrates continuous monitoring, portable biomarker analysis, and high-precision clinical solutions to transform cardiovascular tracking into a preventive, connected, and actionable strategy.
tech.item1_desc: Wrist control center for blood pressure, SpO2, heart rate, and temperature.
tech.item2_desc: Discreet ECG patch that detects arrhythmias and cardiac events while the patient maintains their routine.
tech.item3_desc: Bioimpedance scale for weight and fluid control, key in edema prevention.
tech.item4_desc: Capillary blood analysis in less than 10 minutes for heart failure diagnosis and monitoring.
tech.item5_desc: Digital sensor to measure urine calcium and monitor renal health associated with cardiovascular risk.
tech.item6_desc: Professional electrocardiograph offering complete cardiac reading with hospital-grade quality.
tech.item7_desc: Automated health station for rapid hypertension and cardiovascular risk screening in pharmacies and companies.
